## Historical audit: H0205

**Source:** `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/hint-codex-experiments/runs/codex_parallel_12/lanes/codex_parallel_12_lane4/codex_parallel_12_lane4_shared/hint_gen/obsidian-linter-auto-table-of-contents/trajs.json`. All citations below refer to this file. The supplied observations are complete event observations, not split fragments; character ranges identify their bounds.

| Aspect | Evidence and interpretation |
|---|---|
| Goal and role | The inferred task goal was an Obsidian Linter rule that generates or updates a marker-delimited table of contents. This is a **teacher-only guidance trace**, not a student implementation trace. The guide states that the repository was read-only for this stage (main_agent:event:21, chars [0,7931)). |
| Inputs and exploration | The teacher read a reference diff proposing five changed files (event:1 and event:2, chars [0,45343)), then independently inspected repository listings, registration, option builders, heading regex, ignore handling, an existing rule, and test conventions (events:3–18; for example, event:10 [0,25948), event:17 [0,22772), event:18 [0,5802)). The initial task prompt to the teacher is not visible. |
| Actual change | The teacher wrote an implementation guide to `/tmp/hint_output.md`; the tool confirmed creation (events:19–20, [0,7989) and [0,7892)). The reference diff was **read**, not applied. No repository implementation, branch, or commit is visible; the final guide also says none was created (event:21). |
| Diagnosis versus execution | The guide identified reference-patch limitations: marker regexes accept spaces rather than all whitespace, and replacement branches do not themselves ensure a blank line after the closing marker. It proposed checking these and other edge cases; it did not execute updates or demonstrate failures by running the patch (events:2 and 21). |
| Validation and outcome | The visible commands inspect files and test locations; no test or type-check execution is shown. Metadata reports the **guidance session** completed successfully, not that the software task passed (top_level_metadata [0,11885)). Software correctness and any later student outcome are **unknown**, not an algorithm failure or a verified success. No student receipt or adoption is evidenced merely by the guide’s availability. |

**Lessons and uncertainty.** The transferable observation is that inspecting the real registration and ignore-wrapper paths can expose integration risks that a transformation-only reference misses. The proposed risk that replacing a TOC region could discard masked placeholders follows from the inspected masking/restoration code, but remains untested here (event:17; event:21). Task-specific unresolved questions include marker whitespace and boundaries, title behavior without entries, duplicate-anchor collisions, and idempotence. The reference patch and teacher’s claims are not independent validation of those behaviors. This is a code task, not a scene; object, material, pose, camera, lighting, and render checks are not applicable.
